nodes.name: HrmApplication.java
nodes.summary: Spring Boot application entry point. Enables JPA auditing, async processing, and scheduling. Component scans com.minhtrung.hrm package.

nodes.name: WebConfig.java
nodes.summary: Web MVC configuration: CORS setup for frontend origin, static resource handling for uploaded files, async task executor configuration, and Jackson object mapper customization (date format, serialization).

nodes.name: SecurityConfig.java
nodes.summary: Spring Security configuration: JWT authentication filter chain, stateless session management, public/private endpoint rules, password encoder (BCrypt), and method-level security enablement. Integrates JwtAuthFilter.

nodes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler.java
nodes.summary: Global exception handler: @ControllerAdvice handling AuthenticationException, AttendanceException, LeaveException, OvertimeException, PayrollException, PerformanceException, AssetException, ItTicketException, DocumentException, ResignationException, and generic exceptions. Returns standardized ApiErrorResponse with error code, message, and timestamp.

nodes.name: JwtAuthFilter.java
nodes.summary: JWT authentication filter: extracts token from Authorization header, validates signature and expiration, loads user details, sets SecurityContext. Handles token refresh logic and RequestContext population with user ID and roles.

nodes.name: FileStorageService.java
nodes.summary: File storage service: MinIO integration for upload/download/delete operations. Generates presigned URLs, handles multipart uploads, enforces file type/size limits, and organizes files by bucket (documents, avatars, assets, offboarding).

nodes.name: RequestContext.java
nodes.summary: Request context holder: thread-local storage for current request metadata (userId, userRoles, requestId, ipAddress, userAgent). Used by services for audit logging and tenant isolation.

nodes.name: RequestContextHolder.java
nodes.summary: RequestContext holder utility: static accessor methods for getting/setting/clearing RequestContext. Provides safe access with null checks and auto-cleanup via try-with-resources pattern.

nodes.name: SpecificationScopes.java
nodes.summary: JPA Specification scopes: reusable predicate builders for common query patterns (byUserId, byDepartmentId, byDateRange, byStatus, searchText). Composable with and/or for dynamic filtering across repositories.
